description:
Outcome: evidence demonstrates amended first version on phones, from brief.md except deferred map plus owner email decisions.
Scope: integrated role/journey, priority/cutoff/FIFO/concurrency/auth/digest tests; keyboard/screen-reader/zoom review and plain-language fixes. Excludes: map tests, invented performance targets and user research.
Acceptance: reproducible evidence for all in-scope requirements; no known blocking correctness/privacy/accessibility defects; fictional 40-plot/60-household dataset.
Behaviour: reproducible tracked failures; loading/empty/error states covered.
Verification: automated suite and documented mobile/assistive walkthrough including early new applicant followed by on-time returner, late-returner ordinary category, premature allocation refusal, and daily email recovery. Prerequisites: allocation view, coordinator resolution and daily email. Assumptions: checked browser environments documented.
title: First-version regression and accessibility
